c2_bad.why: The task adds two lines of static copy to an existing buybox; skip links and landmark bypass are a shell concern the page already satisfies and the change does not touch. It was selected 'for required coverage: visible focus', a concept it barely carries, and it displaced a11y-focus-visible, which at least names the scroll-padding rule the sticky bar depends on.

Repeats the c1 false demand: product.html is static with local state, no asynchronous or remote data, so empty/loading/error/partial has nothing to attach to. It costs the slot that impl-reuse-before-new (process.reuse_first, still UNCOVERED) should hold on an existing-UI fix whose whole method was reusing the .trust row grammar.
